narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the Iran-Israel-US conflict escalates asymmetrically, with strikes, retaliation, and Hormuz blockade threats. The market consensus underestimates the persistence and breadth of the conflict, driving safe-haven flows into commodities and out of equities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and gold; short S&P 500 futures and long-dated Treasuries.

narratives.title: Energy Supply Disruption Pricing
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy commodities as the Strait of Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026 per EIA, with Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines. The SPR release is misread as bearish but actually signals supply pre-positioning, reinforcing bullish oil dynamics.
narratives.trade_implication: Buy WTI and Brent futures; long energy sector ETFs; short consumer discretionary.

narratives.title: Risk-Off Liquidation Cascades
narratives.summary: Equity selloffs are accelerating due to algorithmic stop-loss cascades and geopolitical uncertainty, with BTC also crashing on macro risk-off sentiment. Capital is moving to cash and short-duration Treasuries as institutional de-risking dominates.
narratives.trade_implication: Short Nasdaq futures; buy 2-year Treasury notes; increase cash allocation.
